name: swipe-actions
title: Swipe Actions
author: Bhide Svelte
description: A composable swipe actions component for revealing contextual actions.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
	import { cn } from "#lib/utils.js";
	import {
		SwipeAction as Action,
		SwipeActionContent as ActionContent
	} from "./primitives";
	import type { SwipeActionProps } from "./primitives";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		children,
		class: className,
		...restProps
	}: SwipeActionProps = $props();
</script>

<Action
	bind:ref
	class={cn(
		"bg-secondary text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap text-secondary-foreground select-none",
		"focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-foreground",
		"data-armed:brightness-90 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
		className
	)}
	{...restProps}
>
	<ActionContent
		class="min-w-20 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-4"
	>
		{@render children()}
	</ActionContent>
</Action>

<script lang="ts">
	import { cn } from "#lib/utils.js";
	import { SwipeContent as Content } from "./primitives";
	import type { SwipeContentProps } from "./primitives";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		children,
		class: className,
		...restProps
	}: SwipeContentProps = $props();
</script>

<Content
	bind:ref
	class={cn("bg-background data-dragging:cursor-grabbing", className)}
	{...restProps}
>
	{@render children()}
</Content>
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { cn } from "#lib/utils.js";
	import { untrack } from "svelte";
	import { useMotionValueEvent } from "motion-sv";
	import { watch } from "runed";
	import {
		setSwipeActionIdContext,
		useSwipeActions,
		useSwipeItem
	} from "./swipe-actions-context.svelte";
	import type { SwipeActionProps } from "./swipe-actions-types";
	import { sideTravel } from "./swipe-actions-utils";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		children,
		closeOnClick = true,
		class: className,
		onclick,
		...restProps
	}: SwipeActionProps = $props();

	const id = Symbol("swipe-action");
	const item = useSwipeItem();
	const actions = useSwipeActions();
	const primary = $derived(actions.fullSwipe && actions.isOutermost(id));
	const before = $derived(actions.offsetOf(id));

	setSwipeActionIdContext(id);

	function place() {
		if (!ref) return;

		const total =
			actions.side === "left" ? item.leftWidth : item.rightWidth;
		const travel = sideTravel(actions.side, item.x.get());
		const progress = total > 0 ? Math.min(1, travel / total) : 0;
		const direction = actions.side === "left" ? -1 : 1;
		const offset = before * progress * item.collapse.get() * direction;
		ref.style.transform = `translate3d(${offset.toFixed(2)}px, 0, 0)`;
	}

	watch(
		[() => actions.fullSwipe, () => actions.side],
		([fullSwipe, currentSide]) => {
			if (!fullSwipe) return;
			return item.registerFullSwipe(currentSide, id, () => {
				ref?.dispatchEvent(
					new MouseEvent("click", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })
				);
			});
		}
	);

	watch(
		[
			() => before,
			() => actions.side,
			() => item.leftWidth,
			() => item.rightWidth
		],
		place
	);
	useMotionValueEvent(item.x, "change", place);
	useMotionValueEvent(item.collapse, "change", place);

	function handleClick(event: MouseEvent) {
		onclick?.(event as MouseEvent & { currentTarget: HTMLButtonElement });
		if (!event.defaultPrevented && closeOnClick) item.close();
	}

	function attachAction(element: HTMLButtonElement) {
		untrack(() => {
			ref = element;
			place();
		});
		return () => {
			untrack(() => {
				if (ref === element) ref = null;
			});
		};
	}
</script>

<button
	{@attach attachAction}
	type="button"
	data-slot="swipe-action"
	data-armed={item.armed === actions.side && primary ? "" : undefined}
	class={cn(
		"pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 flex",
		actions.side === "left" ? "justify-end" : "justify-start",
		className
	)}
	onclick={handleClick}
	{...restProps}
>
	{@render children()}
</button>
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { cn } from "#lib/utils.js";
	import { motion } from "motion-sv";
	import { useSwipeItem } from "./swipe-actions-context.svelte";
	import type { SwipeContentProps } from "./swipe-actions-types";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		children,
		class: className,
		style,
		...restProps
	}: SwipeContentProps = $props();

	const item = useSwipeItem();
	const dragConstraints = $derived({
		left: -(item.fullSwipeSides.right ? item.itemWidth : item.rightWidth),
		right: item.fullSwipeSides.left ? item.itemWidth : item.leftWidth
	});
</script>

<motion.div
	bind:ref
	{...restProps}
	data-slot="swipe-content"
	data-dragging={item.dragging || undefined}
	class={cn("relative z-1", className)}
	style={{ ...style, x: item.x }}
	drag={item.disabled ? false : "x"}
	{dragConstraints}
	dragElastic={0.2}
	dragMomentum={false}
	onDragStart={item.onDragStart}
	onDrag={item.onDrag}
	onDragEnd={item.onDragEnd}
	onclickcapture={item.onClickCapture}
>
	{@render children()}
</motion.div>
{@render children()}
{@render children()}
